claim: Generalisation: one idealised spherical head, one stand-off, constant 3.24 GHz tissue values; no anatomy variation tested.
Uniform staging: not tested against re-meshing (no rotated uniform head; v1/v2 not a clean re-mesh pair).
Rulers rest on 4 rotated healthy meshes: R31 on Null_rot43, R21 and R32 on Null_rot19; more samples could raise them further.
Reference choice: Healthy_sliced_new is the lowest-R31 healthy mesh; the H6-based re-mesh ruler (0.204 dB) and the mean-based one (0.113 dB) give different detection tiers. Not resolved.
Null_rot19 build: a possible HFSS build difference is being checked by the user; until documented it stays in every ruler.
Weak-path control: the dS < 0.02 stop rule cannot control paths near -55 dB; the effect on the second-neighbour class is untested.
Floor significance: 13 nulls cap the rank p at about 0.07; independence of the 9 aligned-mesh nulls is not established.
Effective sample size: one design per stage; whether v1/v2 Normal/Severe share a mesh is unknown; v1 Mild/Moderate come from another project.
Noise model: chosen, not measured (no VNA/antenna data).
Antenna position error and frequency-dependent cable flex: not modelled.
Per-port phase calibration: every phase statistic needs it; +-10 deg port phase error swamps the left-right phase signal (SD 8.6 deg).
Layer source: Shehab Table 6 not in the repository; realistic 2 mm CSF / 6 mm skull not simulated.
Geometry of v1/v2 (variables, skull hole) and the MCI_lobe ventricle: unaudited.
Materials: skin/fat/skull values in HFSS unknown; AD material provenance unverified.
Post-hoc frequency choices: the 3.30-3.65 GHz window and the sub-band split.
Frontal lobe (Moderate - Mild) was never checked in phase.
Statements in STATUS sections 2-4 (delay numbers, M5.C3 detection row, M5.C2 staging lead, spectral-shape and reflection metrics) were not re-derived.
Imaging-side items (Born error, sector kernels): imaging session's ledger.
Detection threshold tau = -15.27 dB (95% -15.37 to -15.17 dB)
Detection margins (13 nulls): Moderate 3.2x; healthy 2.2-2.9x; Mild 2.3-2.5x; MCI 2.1x; Severe 0.9-1.1x; partial designs 0.5x
Staging labels >= 3x: 0 of 20 (13 nulls); 10 of 20 without Null_rot19
R21 rises 0.131 dB per 10 mm of total cortical retreat (Mild materials); the Normal|Mild edge corresponds to about 33 mm
Healthy_sliced_new R31 is 0.119 dB below the mean of the other five healthy meshes (lowest of six)
Mirror replication: left-right signs repeat 26/26; sizes agree 12/26 (21/26 within the 13-null rulers)
Reflection mirror pairs: left design -0.060 / -0.068 dB, right design +0.070 / +0.073 dB, Test_B -0.066 / +0.068 dB; all 13 nulls below the 0.017 / 0.014 dB one-pass yardsticks
Neighbour-phase left-right: left design -4.4 deg, right design +4.6 deg, Test_B -0.4 deg (3.30-3.65 GHz); healthy meshes up to 1.2 deg
+-10 deg per-port phase error spreads the neighbour-phase left-right by 8.6 deg (SD); +-0.5 dB gain error spreads per-antenna R31 left-right by 0.44 dB
Test_B blind score: detection correct, staging wrong, side correct by definition, 6 sector abstentions, best pattern = truth
Test_B pattern-fit contrast 1.60x the healthy-mesh null (rotated healthy heads 0.63-1.02x)
Sensitivity: 98.7-99.4% in air; in-brain 56-69% above z = 40 mm, <= 4% below z = 0
Detection band: uniform healthy-AD R31 gap 3.4x (3.2-3.5 GHz), 5.7x (3.5-3.8), -7.3x (3.8-4.2)
